positions.description: Summer Intern, Performance Group and Product Marketing. Create an application that collects and presents data from virtualized environment. Define the data to be collected and also write tools to analyze and aggregate the data, including comparison of data across different environments. The application is a middleware written in Java and use virtualization APIs like the VMware Infrastructure Management (VIM) API to retrieve data from the virtualized environment.

projects.title: Private Cloud Enabled Wavelet Enhanced MicroCT Imaging using GPGPU (CUDA)
projects.description:
• Currently working on my Master's project under guidance of Dr. Harry Li to come up with a System that uses MicroCT imaging technique that scans a patient's body part using CCD camera that captures 2D images.
• 2D images are reconstructed into a graphical 3D model using Wavelets which are parallely processed using CUDA and OpenGL. 
• 3D model is hosted on Amazon cloud (for eg: private cloud of a hospital) and can be viewed real-time using an Android mobile application or a Web App providing easy access to doctors and other professionals.
• 6 stepper motors used to capture images and drive the CT scanning mechanism which can be controlled using the mobile and web application.

(Environment - C)
(Platform - ARM11, Linux Device Drivers, Android & Web App Development
